title: Superannuation (Excess Untaxed Roll-over Amounts Tax) Amendment (DisabilityCare Australia) Bill 2013

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would increase the tax charged on excess untaxed superannuation roll-over amounts as part of the DisabilityCare Australia tax amendment package.
It would move the rate from 46.5 per cent to 47 per cent, reflecting the higher Medicare levy alongside the maximum income tax rate.
The increase would apply to excess untaxed roll-over amounts paid on or after 1 July 2014, as a consequential change linked to the levy package.
changes: The tax rate on excess untaxed roll-over amounts would rise by half a percentage point.
The calculation would include a 2 per cent Medicare levy component.
Amounts paid on or after 1 July 2014 would attract the revised rate.
summary.affected: People liable for tax on excess untaxed superannuation roll-over amounts are affected.

speeches.speaker: Bill Shorten
speeches.brief: Moved the Superannuation (Excess Untaxed Roll-Over Amounts Tax) Amendment (DisabilityCare Australia) Bill, proposing that the tax rate on excess untaxed roll-over amounts rise from 46.5 per cent to 47 per cent from 1 July 2014 to reflect the Medicare levy increase.

speeches.speaker: Jacinta Collins
speeches.brief: Moved to suspend standing orders so that 14 bills related to DisabilityCare Australia (the National Disability Insurance Scheme) could be considered during the current sitting period; the motion was agreed to.
